svg.title: Two homelab edges with a WAF on every HTTP service path
svg.desc: Proxied web traffic and direct DNS-only traffic enter either edge. Each HAProxy applies maintenance and access rules before selecting a local or peer private gateway. The selected gateway uses its local WAF and Anubis before the shared private origins. Git SSH is a separate TCP path.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Shared private origins · applications keep their authentication
